correctness.rationale: Euler and the gradient equations show the hyperplane L=0 is defined at every p on the smooth base; the remainder gives a closed incidence proper over U. At λ=0 a diagonal cubic on at least three active coordinates is smooth and irreducible in that active subspace (positive-dimensional projective hypersurface components would intersect); adjoining inactive variables cannot introduce a factor. The one-coordinate centers and the roots r^8=1 on the six two-coordinate lines give 4+48=52. Independently substituting x0=−r³x1−s³x2−t³x3 at λ=0 gives pure-cube coefficients 256(u−u^9) for u=r,s,t. Their derivative is 256 at zero and −2048 at an eighth root. Thus in the completed local ring the pure-cube equations force the constant center, because that center already solves them for all λ. Along it the only remaining coefficient is proportional to λ(1−r^4), including r=0. The resulting full completed local rings are C[[λ]] or C[[λ]]/(λ), giving reduced fiber points and the asserted two types. Properness and zero-dimensional special fiber give finiteness on an open neighborhood. The disjoint union of the indicated closed sections and reduced points embeds into the incidence there; the ideal of that union has zero stalk over the Fermat point by faithful flatness of completion. Its support has closed image by properness and can be removed without removing 0. This proves the algebraic decomposition, not merely a local analytic count. The polar criterion applies outside the quartic; among the 52 centers at 0 precisely the 24 with r^4=−1 lie on it. The frozen symbolic checker was inspected, not run; the proof of the scheme statement is algebraic.
residual_risks: The proof allows shrinking W and does not classify possible nonzero exceptional parameters on the rest of the smooth pencil.

value.rationale: Which projection-symmetry centers survive the natural Fermat deformation is a concrete moduli question. The scheme separates persistent sections from disappearing reduced points, including the 24 interior polar incidences, and proves nonflatness and an exact nearby exterior count. Showing just that the familiar reflections persist would not give this information.
residual_risks: No full-pencil classification or classification of abstract K3 automorphisms is claimed.
